verdict.rationale: Asana ships AI Teammates and AI Studio, so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Asana's own MCP server, which external clients such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to. That is the server role and does not show Asana plugging in third-party MCP servers. The App Directory's generic "context from other apps" claim is adjacent and is not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
